title: example-data-apps index
description: Schema for apps.json — the flat machine-readable index of every synthetic data app in this repo. Produced by scripts/build_index.py from each app's spec.json + meta.json. See README.md for the layout reference and the regen workflow.

$schema.description: Optional — points readers + IDE validators at this schema. Set by build_index.py to the absolute schema URL on GitHub.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when scripts/build_index.py last wrote the file.

total.description: Length of the apps array. Must equal sum(categories[].count).

categories.description: One entry per distinct category, sorted by count descending.

apps.description: Flat list of every app. Sorted by (category, slug).

label.description: Human-facing category name (e.g. 'Operations / Logistics'). Author-stamped in each app's meta.json events[].detail.

slug.description: Directory name for this category under apps/.

count.description: Number of apps in this category. Must equal len([a for a in apps if a.category_slug == this.slug]).

slug.description: App directory name. Unique across the repo.

name.description: Human-facing display name (from spec.json.name). The questions/*.tsv benchmark references apps by this field.

description.description: One-paragraph description (from spec.json.description). May be empty if the source spec has no description.

category.description: Canonical category label. Variant labels are normalized via LABEL_ALIASES in build_index.py.

category_slug.description: Directory name of the category under apps/. Cross-references categories[].slug.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the app directory. Always ends in a trailing slash. Format: apps/<category_slug>/<slug>/.

ir_version.description: spec.json.irVersion — currently '3.0' for the corpus. Empty string if missing.

data_sources.description: spec.json.dataSources — list of source identifiers the app reads from. Empty array if missing.

kebabSlug.description: lowercase-kebab identifier. No leading/trailing hyphens, no consecutive hyphens, no uppercase or punctuation.
